detalhe.sem_descricao: This job came without a description.
detalhe.abrir_no_site_nova_aba: Open on Site (opens in a new tab)
detalhe.encaixe.sem_nota: No fit score for this search.
detalhe.habilidades.origem: What the job asks for, according to the AI ({backend}, {modelo}).
detalhe.habilidades.cortado: The AI read only part of the job text.
detalhe.faixa.titulo: Job dates over the next 12 months
detalhe.correcao.dica: Fix what is wrong, one item at a time. The job shows up corrected right away, and the correction also holds in future searches.
detalhe.correcao.dica.salario: Write it as in the job: 6,000 per month or USD 6,000 per month. Empty means the job gives no salary.
detalhe.correcao.dica.outro: Tell us what is wrong. It stays as a comment only, the job does not change.
detalhe.correcao.erro.uf: Use the two-letter state code: SP.
detalhe.correcao.erro.salario: I could not read the salary. Write the amount and the period: USD 6,000 per month.
detalhe.correcao.erro.comentario: The comment is over the {max} letter limit.
detalhe.correcao.erro.longo: The value is over the {max} letter limit.
detalhe.candidatar_email_rotulo: Apply by email (opens your email app)
detalhe.email.nao_copiou: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it.
detalhe.email.aviso: joBot doesn't send anything: the email goes out from your email app.
detalhe.candidatura.ligar: For the AI to write the cover letter and the summary, turn the task on in Settings › AI.
detalhe.candidatura.sem_perfil: To prepare, the AI needs your profile: add skills, experience, courses or a summary in Settings › Profile.
detalhe.candidatura.privacidade.desligad: The AI is off: nothing leaves your computer.
detalhe.candidatura.privacidade.local: Your profile and the job text stay on your computer: it uses the local model.
detalhe.candidatura.privacidade.fora: Your profile and the job text go to {servico}. Name, email, phone and city don't.
detalhe.candidatura.privacidade.manual: Nothing goes out by itself: you copy the request (your profile, without name, email, phone and city, and the job text) and paste it into the AI chat you choose.
detalhe.candidatura.preparando: Preparing: the AI is writing the cover letter and the summary (with the local model it can take a few minutes).
detalhe.candidatura.recarregar: Reload the page to see the result.
detalhe.candidatura.falha.contexto: The job and your profile together are longer than the model accepts. Shorten your profile (summary and experience) and try again.
detalhe.candidatura.falha_manual: Couldn't read the pasted answer: copy only the JSON the chat answered and paste it again.
detalhe.candidatura.nao_copiou: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
detalhe.candidatura.editar: You can edit the text before copying; the edit isn't saved.
detalhe.candidatura.sem_pede: The AI hasn't read what this job asks for yet: no list of what you have and what's missing for now.
detalhe.candidatura.usou_nada: The AI didn't say which data from your profile it used.
detalhe.candidatura.aviso: Check before using: the AI can be wrong.
detalhe.candidatura.citado: The cover letter mentions something that isn't in your profile: {lista}
detalhe.candidatura.perguntas: New questions for your profile (answer them in Settings › Profile):
detalhe.candidatura.nao_envia: joBot doesn't send anything: copy and use it wherever you want.
detalhe.candidatura.manual.passo1: 1. Copy the request below and paste it into the AI chat you choose.
detalhe.candidatura.manual.passo2: 2. Paste the chat's answer (the JSON) here and click Read the Answer.
